meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会把代码库里的每个源文件从头到尾完整读一遍，大文件会分页读完，从而全面掌握项目代码，方便后续开发修改。
howto.when: 当你开始新项目、面对不熟悉的代码库，或说“学习代码库”“读取代码库”“prime”等时触发。

say.text: 请通读这个项目的所有源代码文件。
say.note: Claude 会逐个文件完整阅读源码。

say.text: 先学习一下代码库，再开始修改。
say.note: Claude 会先通读全部源码再动手。

say.text: 把这个项目所有源文件按顺序读完。
say.note: 会触发全量阅读，可能耗时较长。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads every source file in the codebase in full, paging through large files, so it gains a thorough understanding of the project for later development.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting a new project, facing an unfamiliar codebase, or when the user says 'learn the codebase', 'read the codebase', 'prime', etc.

say_en.text: Please read all source files in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will read each file completely.

say_en.text: Learn the codebase first, then make changes.
say_en.note: Claude reads all code before editing.

say_en.text: Read every source file in this repo in order.
say_en.note: Triggers full reading; may take time.
